outcome: time to complete expulsion of fetus
complications (nausea, vomiting, fever, uterine rupture, post-abortive bleeding)
cohort: 56 women with a previous cesarean section undergoing second-trimester abortion between 13 and 18 weeks of gestation.
finding: There was no significant difference between Dilapan-s and misoprostol in terms of time to expulsion, successful abortion, need for surgical evacuation, complications, hospital stay duration, or pain.
